rules.rule: Each contract document accepts up to three cumulative files, with unchanged 20 MB, authorization, transaction, idempotency and first-return facts.
rules.source: 2026-11-09 user: 每个合同版本最多三份，一个入口；按钮叫“查看回签文件”；开工并入main。既定补传不更新首次回传日期与时效；不部署。
rules.initialization: No schema/seed/backfill change. Existing one/two files can append; over-three evidence retained; fresh marked local PostgreSQL 18.6 low-privilege schema created and removed by existing fixture.
rules.dateAndPermission: Unchanged actor and attachment ownership checks; append two/three preserves first returned_at, late status and overdue hours; old/new document quota isolated.
rules.expectation: Three succeed, fourth refuses, only one competitor wins the last slot, no retry duplicate or historic rewrite.

rules.rule: One exact 查看回签文件 entry opens all authorized files, deduplicates aggregate/history and keeps contract versions and unknown versions separate.

rules.initialization: No new API or data migration. Groups derive only from authorized existing response; legacy excess files remain visible without slicing.
rules.dateAndPermission: No new role grants or file endpoints; existing permission-filtered response and preview/download authorization retained. Historical submission dates kept.
rules.expectation: Desktop/mobile one entry, mixed file switch, historical grouping, failure fallback, long names and Escape focus restoration; empty permission response has no entry.
